attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Milestones are part of the project's WBS, enabling financial gating and milestone‑based funding releases.

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the design milestone was actually achieved and formally signed off. Null if the milestone has not yet been completed. Compared against planned_date to compute schedule variance for TTM reporting.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: approval_disposition
attributes.description: Formal outcome decision rendered at the gate review for this milestone. approved = unconditional sign-off; conditionally_approved = sign-off with mandatory action items; rejected = milestone failed, rework required; deferred = review postponed to a later date; waived = milestone formally bypassed with documented justification. Distinct from milestone_status which tracks workflow state.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: blocker_count
attributes.description: Number of critical blocking issues preventing milestone achievement or sign-off at the time of review. Blockers are issues that must be fully resolved before the milestone can be approved, distinct from action items which may be post-approval.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: blocker_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of critical blocking issues preventing milestone sign-off. Details the nature of each blocker (e.g., unresolved DRC violations, failing timing paths, missing PDK sign-off) and the responsible owner for resolution.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this design milestone record was first created in the system of record. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting per SOX and ISO 9001 requirements.

attributes.name: dfm_sign_off
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether DFM (Design for Manufacturability) analysis has been completed and signed off at this milestone. True = DFM rules verified and approved by the process engineering team; False = DFM sign-off pending or not applicable for this milestone type.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus; SEMI Standards; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: dft_sign_off
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether DFT (Design for Testability) implementation and ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) coverage requirements have been met and signed off at this milestone. True = DFT sign-off complete; False = DFT sign-off pending.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; JEDEC; IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG); ISO 9001

attributes.name: die_area_mm2
attributes.description: Physical die area in square millimeters (mm²) as estimated or finalized at this design milestone. Part of the PPA (Power, Performance, Area) triad. Tracked across milestones from initial floorplan through tapeout to monitor area budget compliance.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus; SEMI Standards; JEDEC

attributes.name: drc_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of unresolved Design Rule Check (DRC) violations present in the design at the time of this milestone review. A value of zero is required for DRC/LVS clean and tapeout readiness milestones. Non-zero values must be accompanied by waivers.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus; KLA ICOS Inspection Systems; SEMI Standards; JEDEC

attributes.name: eda_tool_version
attributes.description: Version of the primary EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tool used to achieve or verify this milestone (e.g., Cadence Innovus 21.1, Synopsys PrimeTime 2022.03). Supports design data provenance and reproducibility of sign-off results.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus; Synopsys Design Compiler and PrimeTime; IEEE 1685

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification of the IC design at this milestone under US EAR (Export Administration Regulations) and ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations). Determines applicable export license requirements for design data sharing and tapeout submission to foreign foundries. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: EAR/BIS; ITAR; CHIPS Act Compliance; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of key findings, observations, and issues identified during the gate review. Captures design quality concerns, DRC/LVS violations, timing closure gaps, DFM/DFT issues, and other technical findings that inform the approval disposition.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: gate_criteria_met
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether all formally defined entry and exit criteria for this gate milestone were satisfied at the time of review. True = all criteria met; False = one or more criteria failed or outstanding. Drives approval disposition and tapeout authorization decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; IATF 16949; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: gate_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the formal gate review meeting or sign-off event occurred. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this transaction record, enabling audit trail and tapeout authorization traceability.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: gds_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the GDS (Graphic Data System) or GDSII layout file submitted or reviewed at this milestone. Provides design data provenance for tapeout authorization and enables traceability between the milestone record and the physical layout database.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus; SEMI Standards; IEEE 1685

attributes.name: ip_clearance_confirmed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether all third-party IP (Intellectual Property) cores used in the design have been cleared for use at this milestone, including license verification and export control review under ITAR and EAR regulations.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ITAR; EAR/BIS; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: lvs_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of unresolved Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) violations present in the design at the time of this milestone review. LVS violations indicate discrepancies between the physical layout and the circuit schematic. Must be zero for tapeout authorization.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus; SEMI Standards; JEDEC

attributes.name: milestone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this milestone within the design project (e.g., MS-RTL-001, MS-TAPEOUT-003). Used as the business-facing reference in PLM and project management systems. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; IEEE 1685

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the design milestone or gate review event (e.g., RTL Freeze, Design Freeze, Netlist Freeze, Floorplan Complete, Timing Closure, DRC/LVS Clean, Tapeout Readiness). Provides the identity label for the milestone record.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IEEE 1685; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the design milestone gate review. planned = milestone scheduled but review not yet initiated; in_review = gate review meeting in progress or findings under evaluation; approved = all gate criteria met and sign-off granted; conditionally_approved = sign-off granted subject to outstanding action items or waivers; rejected = gate criteria not met, design must remediate before re-review; waived = milestone bypassed under formal waiver authority.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the milestone representing the specific lifecycle checkpoint in the IC design flow. Values: rtl_freeze (Register Transfer Level code locked), design_freeze (all design changes halted), netlist_freeze (synthesized netlist locked), floorplan_complete (physical floorplan approved), timing_closure (all timing constraints met per PrimeTime signoff), drc_lvs_clean (Design Rule Check and Layout Versus Schematic violations resolved), tapeout_readiness (GDS/GDSII submission authorized). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rtl_freeze|design_freeze|netlist_freeze|floorplan_complete|timing_closure|drc_lvs_clean|tapeout_readiness — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus; Synopsys Design Compiler and PrimeTime; IEEE 1685; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: nre_phase
attributes.description: NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) lifecycle phase to which this milestone belongs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|architecture|rtl_design|physical_design|verification|tapeout|post_silicon — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; SAP S/4HANA CO; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: open_action_item_count

attributes.name: open_waiver_count

attributes.name: pdk_version

attributes.name: review_iteration

attributes.name: review_meeting_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the formal gate review meeting was convened with all required participants. May differ from gate_review_timestamp if the sign-off decision was rendered after the meeting concluded.

attributes.name: review_participant_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of names or employee IDs of individuals who participated in the gate review meeting. Includes design engineers, DFM/DFT leads, physical design leads, and program management. Supports audit trail and quorum validation.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ISO 9001; IATF 16949; SOX

attributes.name: revised_target_date

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the actual milestone date deviates from the planned date (actual_date minus planned_date). Positive values indicate delay; negative values indicate early completion. Used for TTM (Time to Market) schedule adherence analytics.

Ensures systematic verification coverage and regulatory compliance before tapeout.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.qualification_status. Business justification: In automotive semiconductor programs, verification plans must align with customer qualification requirements (AEC-Q, IATF 16949, PPAP). This FK links the verification plan's signoff criteria directly

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific RTL or netlist design revision under verification. Ensures the verification plan is tied to a precise design snapshot, supporting traceability from verification results back to the design state at time of sign-off.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus, Synopsys Design Compiler, Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: test_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.test_plan. Business justification: Design verification plans reference quality test plans to align functional verification coverage with quality acceptance criteria. Semiconductor DV engineers coordinate with quality teams to ensure ve

attributes.name: assertion_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) or PSL assertions that must be exercised and pass during simulation. Assertion coverage is a key metric for protocol compliance and corner-case verification completeness.

attributes.name: bug_tracking_project_key
attributes.description: Project key or identifier in the bug tracking system corresponding to this verification plan (e.g., 'SOC-X5-VER'). Used to hyperlink verification failures to the defect management workflow.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM, Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: bug_tracking_system
attributes.description: Name of the defect/bug tracking system integrated with this verification plan for logging simulation failures and RTL bugs (e.g., 'Jira', 'Bugzilla', 'Synopsys Serenity'). Enables traceability from verification failures to RTL fixes.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: code_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target code coverage closure percentage (line, branch, condition, expression, FSM) required for sign-off. Complements functional coverage to ensure structural completeness of the RTL simulation. Tracked against EDA tool-reported actuals.
attributes.references: IEEE 1800 (SystemVerilog), Synopsys VCS / Cadence Xcelium coverage reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this design verification plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements.

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IC design type under verification. Determines the applicable verification strategies, IP reuse policies, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASIC|SoC|FPGA|IP_core|ASSP|MCU|GPU|DSP — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dft_strategy
attributes.description: Primary DFT strategy defined in the verification plan for post-silicon test coverage. Scan chain inserts flip-flop chains for structural test; BIST (Built-In Self-Test) embeds test logic on-chip; ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) generates test vectors; boundary scan (JTAG per IEEE 1149.1) tests board-level interconnects. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scan_chain|BIST|ATPG|boundary_scan|JTAG|combined|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG/Boundary Scan), IEEE 1500 (Embedded Core Test), JEDEC, DFT (Design for Testability) standards

attributes.name: emulation_platform
attributes.description: Hardware emulation platform used for pre-silicon software bring-up and system-level verification (e.g., 'Cadence Palladium Z2', 'Synopsys ZeBu', 'Mentor Veloce'). Null if emulation is not in scope for this plan.

attributes.name: fault_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target stuck-at and transition fault coverage percentage for ATPG-generated test patterns. Typically 99%+ for automotive/safety-critical designs per IATF 16949 and ISO 26262. Drives DFT insertion effort and scan chain architecture decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 26262, IATF 16949, JEDEC, IEEE 1149.1, ATPG methodology

attributes.name: fault_injection_campaign_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether a structured fault injection campaign is planned as part of this verification plan to validate safety mechanisms per ISO 26262. True for ASIL-B and above designs. Drives resource allocation for fault simulation infrastructure.

attributes.name: fmeda_document_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode Effects and Diagnostic Analysis (FMEDA) Document ID
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the linked FMEDA document in the PLM system. The FMEDA quantifies diagnostic coverage and safe failure fraction for ISO 26262 hardware metrics compliance. Null for non-safety designs.
attributes.references: ISO 26262 Part 5 (Hardware Safety Requirements), IEC 61508, FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) standards

attributes.name: formal_verification_tool
attributes.description: EDA tool used for formal property checking and equivalence checking (e.g., 'Synopsys VC Formal', 'Cadence JasperGold', 'OneSpin 360'). Null if formal verification is not part of the plan methodology.
attributes.references: EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tool standards, IEEE 1800 (SystemVerilog)

attributes.name: fpga_prototype_platform
attributes.description: FPGA prototyping board or platform used for early software validation and system integration testing (e.g., 'Xilinx VCU128', 'Intel Stratix 10 GX', 'Aldec HES-US-440'). Null if FPGA prototyping is not in scope.
attributes.references: FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array) prototyping standards, JEDEC

attributes.name: functional_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target functional coverage closure percentage required for verification sign-off (e.g., 99.50 for 99.5%). Defined in the verification plan and tracked against actual coverage results from simulation regression runs. A key tapeout readiness gate metric.

attributes.name: ip_reuse_count
attributes.description: Number of third-party or internal IP cores integrated into this design that require verification waivers or pre-verified IP sign-off. Impacts the scope of the verification plan and the testbench architecture for IP interface compliance.
attributes.references: IEEE 1500 (Embedded Core Test), Siemens Teamcenter PLM, IP (Intellectual Property Core) management

attributes.name: iso26262_asil_decomposition
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISO 26262 Automotive Safety Integrity Level (ASIL) Decomposition Description
attributes.description: Description of the ASIL decomposition strategy applied to this design per ISO 26262 Part 9. Documents how a higher ASIL requirement is decomposed into two independent lower-ASIL sub-elements (e.g., 'ASIL D decomposed to ASIL B + ASIL B'). Mandatory for automotive safety-critical IC designs.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this design verification plan record. Used for change tracking, PLM synchronization, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act), ISO 9001, Oracle Agile PLM, Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version of the foundry-provided PDK used in this design and verification environment. The PDK defines the design rules, device models, and standard cell libraries. Verification must be validated against the correct PDK version to ensure DFM compliance.
attributes.references: PDK (Process Design Kit) standards, SEMI, Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for all verification activities and sign-off, aligned with the tapeout schedule. A key TTM (Time to Market) planning date. Slippage triggers NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) cost impact analysis.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name for the verification plan, typically including the IC design project name and verification phase (e.g., 'SoC-X5 Full-Chip Functional Verification Plan v2.1'). Used in dashboards, reports, and PLM document management.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable identifier for the verification plan, typically assigned by the PLM system (e.g., Oracle Agile PLM or Siemens Teamcenter). Format: DVP-<PROJECT_CODE>-<YEAR>-<SEQ>. Used in cross-functional communications, tapeout checklists, and audit trails.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM, Siemens Teamcenter PLM, IEEE 1012

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for verification activities as defined in the project schedule. Used for milestone tracking, resource planning, and TTM (Time to Market) analysis.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, SAP S/4HANA PP (Production Planning)

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the verification plan document. Drives workflow approvals and tapeout gate readiness. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|active|on_hold|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM, Siemens Teamcenter PLM, IEEE 1012

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the verification plan document following semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0', '2.3', '3.1.2'). Incremented upon each approved revision cycle in the PLM system. Critical for traceability to tapeout sign-off.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM, Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: regression_run_frequency
attributes.description: Planned frequency at which the regression suite is executed. Continuous integration runs on every RTL commit; nightly runs are scheduled overnight; milestone-triggered runs occur at defined project gates; on-demand runs are manually initiated.
attributes.references: IEEE 1012, EDA (Electronic Design Automation) CI/CD best practices

attributes.name: regression_suite_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary regression test suite defined in this verification plan (e.g., 'SoC_Full_Regression_v3', 'CPU_Smoke_Suite'). The regression suite defines the set of simulation tests run nightly or at milestone gates to track coverage progress.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus, Synopsys Design Compiler, IEEE 1012

attributes.name: safety_criticality_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automotive Safety Integrity Level (ASIL) / Safety Integrity Level (SIL) Classification
attributes.description: Functional safety classification of the IC design per ISO 26262 (automotive ASIL) or IEC 61508 (industrial SIL). Drives the rigor of fault injection campaigns, FMEDA linkage, and safety mechanism coverage targets within the verification plan. Non-safety designs are tagged 'non_safety'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASIL_A|ASIL_B|ASIL_C|ASIL_D|SIL_1|SIL_2|SIL_3|non_safety — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: safety_mechanism_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of identified safety mechanisms that must be verified through simulation, formal analysis, or fault injection campaigns. Required for ISO 26262 hardware verification sign-off. Null for non-safety designs.

attributes.name: scan_chain_count
attributes.description: Number of scan chains defined in the DFT architecture for this design. Determines ATPG test time, test data volume, and ATE (Automatic Test Equipment) channel requirements. A key DFT planning parameter.
attributes.references: IEEE 1149.1, JEDEC, ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) methodology

attributes.name: signoff_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether all verification sign-off criteria have been met and formal approval has been granted to proceed to tapeout. True only after all coverage targets, regression pass rates, and safety requirements are satisfied.

attributes.name: signoff_criteria_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the complete set of criteria that must be satisfied before verification sign-off is granted and tapeout is authorized. Includes coverage closure thresholds, zero-open-critical-bug requirement, regression pass rate, and formal proof completion.

attributes.name: signoff_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which verification sign-off was formally approved. Null until sign-off is granted. Used for tapeout readiness confirmation and post-silicon correlation analysis.

attributes.name: simulation_tool
attributes.description: Primary EDA simulation tool assigned for RTL and gate-level simulation (e.g., 'Synopsys VCS', 'Cadence Xcelium', 'Mentor Questa'). Determines the simulation environment configuration, license requirements, and regression infrastructure.
attributes.references: EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tool standards, Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus, Synopsys Design Compiler

attributes.name: tapeout_target_date
attributes.description: Target date for GDSII tapeout submission to the foundry. The verification plan must achieve all sign-off criteria before this date. Drives the verification schedule and milestone gate definitions.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards, Siemens Teamcenter PLM, GDS (Graphic Data System) / GDSII tapeout process

attributes.name: testbench_architecture
attributes.description: Structural architecture of the simulation testbench. UVM_layered follows the standard UVM agent/scoreboard/coverage hierarchy; directed uses manually written test vectors; constrained_random uses SystemVerilog randomization; cocotb uses Python-based co-simulation; SystemC uses transaction-level modeling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UVM_layered|directed|constrained_random|hybrid|cocotb|SystemC — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: toggle_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target toggle coverage percentage for all RTL signals, ensuring each net transitions both 0→1 and 1→0 during simulation. Used as a DFT readiness indicator and a structural verification completeness metric.
attributes.references: IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG/Boundary Scan), Synopsys Design Compiler, ATPG standards

attributes.name: verification_methodology
attributes.description: Primary pre-silicon verification methodology employed for this plan. UVM (Universal Verification Methodology) is the industry-standard constrained-random simulation approach; formal uses mathematical property checking; emulation uses hardware accelerators; FPGA_prototyping uses field-programmable gate arrays for early software bring-up. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UVM|formal|emulation|FPGA_prototyping|hybrid|mixed_signal — promote to reference product]

domains.name: process
domains.description: Process engineering data for all semiconductor manufacturing process flows including photolithography, etch, diffusion, implant, deposition, and metrology steps. Manages SPC control charts, process capability indices, OPC rule sets, MEEF parameters, process qualification, yield optimization, and technology node readiness.

products.name: flow
products.description: Master definition of a semiconductor manufacturing process flow (recipe sequence) for a given technology node. Captures the ordered sequence of unit process steps from FEOL through MOL and BEOL, including process node designation (e.g., 5nm, 3nm, 28nm), flow revision, qualification status, applicable device families, and PDK linkage. SSOT for all process flow definitions used in wafer fabrication.

attributes.name: flow_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the semiconductor manufacturing process flow definition. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

Supports fab layout planning, material handling automation, and flow-level logistics optimization in sem

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Export compliance review requires each process flow to be linked to the specific export license governing the technology used.

attributes.name: family_id

products.name: recipe

Captures recipe name, version, tool class, chamber configuration, and all process parameter setpoints organized by process type: implant conditions (species, energy, dose, tilt, twist, beam current, anneal recipe), deposition conditions (method such as LPCVD/PECVD/ALD/PVD/EPI, target material, thickness, temperature, pressure, precursor flows, RF power, deposition rate, uniformity spec), etch conditions (type, chemistry, gas flows, pressure, RF source/bias power, etch rate, selectivity, CD bias, endpoint detection), CMP conditions (slurry, pad, platen pressure, carrier speed, table speed, endpoint detection, removal target, post-CMP clean, uniformity spec), and lithography conditions (scanner, wavelength, NA, sigma, illumination mode, resist type/thickness, exposure dose, focus offset, develop process, bake temperatures, OPC rule set reference). Includes recipe approval status, effective date range, qualification linkage, and full revision history. Sourced from Applied Materials SmartFactory MES and Camstar MES recipe management modules. products.name: lot_process_run
products.description: Transactional record of a wafer lot executing a specific process step on a specific piece of equipment. products.name: spc_control_chart
products.description: Statistical Process Control (SPC) control chart definition and complete measurement history for a monitored process parameter at a specific process step. Chart definition captures chart type (Xbar-R, Xbar-S, EWMA, CUSUM, IMR), monitored parameter name, control limits (UCL, LCL, UWL, LWL), target value, sample size, sampling frequency, chart owner, and current chart status. Measurement detail (header+line pattern) captures all individual data points: measured value, measurement timestamp, lot reference, wafer number, site coordinates, measurement tool ID, chart rule violations triggered (Western Electric rules, Nelson rules), and resulting process action (none, warning, OCAP triggered). Implements SEMI E10 and JEDEC SPC guidelines. Sourced from KLA ICOS and in-line metrology tools. SSOT for all SPC monitoring definitions and measurement data in the process domain.

products.name: opc_rule_set
products.description: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) rule set and MEEF characterization record for a specific lithography layer and technology node. Captures OPC model version, target layer name, technology node, lithography wavelength (EUV/DUV), scanner NA, illumination mode, rule set file reference, process bias tables, assist feature rules, qualification status, and complete MEEF characterization (MEEF value per feature type, pitch, CD target, process window DOF/EL, sigma illumination, NA, wavelength, measurement methodology). MEEF parameters are integral attributes of the OPC rule set as they characterize mask-to-wafer CD transfer fidelity within the OPC model context. Managed in conjunction with Synopsys and Cadence EDA OPC flows. SSOT for all OPC, MEEF, and lithography proximity correction data used in mask data preparation and CD tolerance specification.

attributes.name: nonconformance_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance_report. Business justification: Yield loss events trigger nonconformance reports in semiconductor quality systems. While yield_loss_event already links to capa_record, the direct link to NCR is distinct — NCRs capture the formal qua

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process step at which the yield loss was identified. Links to process step master data.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Yield losses directly impact profit center P&L through scrap costs and lost revenue. Required for financial impact reporting of yield excursions and profit center variance analysis in semiconductor op

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process recipe or run card that was active when the yield loss event occurred. Used for recipe-specific yield correlation and optimization.

attributes.name: root_cause_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Yield loss root cause often traces to supplier material issues (e.g., contaminated chemical batch, out-of-spec wafer substrate). Essential for triggering supplier corrective action requests (SCAR), co

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IC design product or device family being fabricated on the affected wafer lot. Used for product-specific yield analysis and customer impact assessment.

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.spc_control_chart. Business justification: yield_loss_event has spc_rule_violation: STRING which is a denormalized reference to an SPC violation. Adding spc_control_chart_id as a proper FK links the yield loss event to the specific SPC control

attributes.name: step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_step. Business justification: A yield loss event is identified at a specific process step or inspection point (per the product description). Without a direct FK to process_step, the yield loss event cannot be directly associated w

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.tool_chamber. Business justification: Yield loss often isolated to specific chamber. Disposition decisions, 8D problem solving, and corrective action (chamber PM, requalification) require chamber-level attribution in semiconductor fabs.

attributes.name: affected_die_count
attributes.description: Number of individual die on the wafer affected by this yield loss event. Used to calculate yield impact and prioritize corrective actions.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer or team assigned to investigate and resolve the yield loss event. Used for workload management and escalation.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: cpk_value
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cpk) calculated at the time of the yield loss event. Indicates how well the process is centered and controlled relative to specification limits. Values below 1.33 typically indicate process capability issues.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this yield loss event record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: defect_density_per_cm2
attributes.description: Measured defect density for this yield loss event, expressed as defects per square centimeter of wafer area. Used for SPC trending and yield modeling.
attributes.references: SEMI E35 - Guide for Reporting Semiconductor Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability Data

attributes.name: defect_size_nm
attributes.description: Measured or estimated size of the defect in nanometers. Critical for determining defect criticality and kill ratio at advanced technology nodes.

attributes.name: defect_type
attributes.description: Specific defect type or signature identified during inspection or test. Examples include scratch, particle, void, short, open, bridging, residue, etc. May reference defect classification taxonomy.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method or technique used to detect the yield loss event. Indicates whether detected via inline inspection, offline inspection, electrical test, parametric test, visual inspection, or metrology measurement.

attributes.name: disposition_action
attributes.description: Disposition decision for the affected wafer lot following yield loss event investigation. Continue indicates lot proceeds to next step; rework indicates reprocessing required; scrap indicates lot rejected; quarantine indicates lot held pending further analysis; use as is indicates lot accepted with deviation; return to vendor indicates supplier material issue.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: estimated_yield_impact_percent
attributes.description: Estimated percentage point impact on wafer yield attributable to this event. Calculated from affected die count and total die per wafer. Used for yield loss Pareto analysis.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the yield loss event was detected or recorded. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where the yield loss event occurred. Used for multi-site yield benchmarking and site-specific trending.

attributes.name: investigation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when root cause investigation of the yield loss event was initiated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this yield loss event record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process layer or mask level at which the yield loss event occurred. Examples include M1, M2, POLY, CONTACT, VIA1, etc. Aligns with GDS layer naming convention.

attributes.name: lot_hold_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lot hold was placed on the affected wafer lot as a result of this yield loss event. True if hold applied; false if no hold applied.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, observations, or context related to the yield loss event. May include investigation findings, lessons learned, or special handling instructions.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: reported_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer, operator, or automated system that reported or logged the yield loss event. Used for accountability and follow-up.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the yield loss event resolution workflow. Open indicates newly detected; under investigation indicates active RCA; root cause identified indicates RCA complete; corrective action implemented indicates fix deployed; closed indicates event resolved; deferred indicates event accepted or postponed.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the yield loss event was resolved and closed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used to calculate mean time to resolution (MTTR) for yield events.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause of the yield loss event. Equipment indicates tool-related issues; material indicates incoming material defects; process indicates recipe or parameter issues; human indicates operator error; environmental indicates cleanroom or facility issues; design indicates layout or design rule issues.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified or suspected root cause of the yield loss event. Populated during root cause analysis and investigation.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Business severity classification of the yield loss event based on yield impact, affected volume, and customer impact. Critical indicates immediate action required; major indicates significant yield impact; minor indicates localized impact; negligible indicates minimal business impact.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: wafer_position_x_mm
attributes.description: X-coordinate position on the wafer where the yield loss event was detected, in millimeters from wafer center. Used for spatial yield analysis and wafer mapping.

attributes.name: wafer_position_y_mm
attributes.description: Y-coordinate position on the wafer where the yield loss event was detected, in millimeters from wafer center. Used for spatial yield analysis and wafer mapping.

attributes.name: yield_loss_mode
attributes.description: Classification of the yield loss mechanism. Parametric indicates out-of-spec electrical parameters; systematic indicates repeatable defect patterns; random indicates sporadic defects; electrical indicates functional failures; particle indicates contamination; pattern indicates lithography or etch issues; edge indicates wafer edge exclusion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parametric|systematic|random|electrical|particle|pattern|edge — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

products.name: defect_inspection_result
products.description: Wafer-level defect inspection result record from in-line inspection tools (KLA brightfield/darkfield scanners, e-beam inspection) captured at process engineering inspection steps for process monitoring and excursion detection. Captures wafer lot reference, inspection step, tool ID, inspection recipe, total defect count, defect density (defects/cm²), defect map file reference, defect classification breakdown by type and size, nuisance filter applied, and disposition. SSOT boundary: process domain owns in-line defect inspection results used for process monitoring, SPC, and excursion detection during manufacturing; quality domain owns outgoing quality inspection, reliability defect analysis, and customer-reported defect records. Sourced from KLA 29xx/39xx series and Applied Materials SEMVision.
products.reference: KLA ICOS / SEMI M1 Defect Inspection

attributes.name: defect_inspection_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the defect inspection result record. Primary key.

attributes.name: defect_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.defect_record. Business justification: Defect inspection results in the process domain feed into formal defect records in the quality domain. This is a core process→quality data flow in semiconductor fabs — inspection results become qualit

attributes.name: defect_step_id
attributes.description: FK to process.process_process_step.process_process_step_id — Defect inspections occur at specific process steps in the flow. Step reference provides manufacturing context for defect analysis.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inspection equipment used (e.g., KLA 29xx/39xx series, Applied Materials SEMVision). Tool asset identifier from equipment master.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process generation) for which this inspection was performed, e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot that was inspected. Links to the fabrication wafer lot being monitored.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Defect inspection results are analyzed per IC product for the Defect Analysis per Product report.

attributes.name: inspection_recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inspection recipe or program used to configure the tool for this inspection run. Defines sensitivity, scan area, and detection parameters.

attributes.name: lot_process_run_id
attributes.description: FK to process.lot_process_run.lot_process_run_id — Defect inspection results are captured during or after a specific lot process run at an inspection step. This FK enables defect-to-process correlation.

attributes.name: nonconformance_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance_report. Business justification: Defect inspection results exceeding thresholds trigger nonconformance reports in semiconductor quality systems. Quality engineers must link inspection results to NCRs for disposition decisions, custom

attributes.name: primary_defect_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Defect inspection results are tied to a specific process step; adding internal FK enables step‑level analysis.

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.spc_control_chart. Business justification: Defect inspection results are monitored via SPC control charts (defect density, defect count per wafer). The defect_inspection_result table has spc_control_limit_lower and spc_control_limit_upper fiel

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.tool_chamber. Business justification: Defect patterns often chamber-specific (particle sources, process drift). SPC monitoring, chamber matching studies, and maintenance prioritization require chamber-level defect attribution in semicondu

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific wafer within the lot that was inspected.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this defect inspection result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crystal_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as crystal originated particles (COPs) or intrinsic silicon defects.

attributes.name: defect_density_per_cm2
attributes.description: Calculated defect density expressed as defects per square centimeter of inspected wafer area. Key metric for process monitoring and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

attributes.name: defect_map_file_format
attributes.description: Format of the defect map file: KLARF (KLA Results File), CSV, XML, or proprietary vendor format.

attributes.name: defect_map_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or URI to the defect map file (typically KLARF or proprietary format) containing spatial coordinates and attributes of all detected defects.

attributes.name: defect_size_bin_large_count
attributes.description: Number of defects in the large size bin (typically > 0.5 µm or tool-specific threshold).

attributes.name: defect_size_bin_medium_count
attributes.description: Number of defects in the medium size bin (typically 0.1-0.5 µm or tool-specific threshold).

attributes.name: defect_size_bin_small_count
attributes.description: Number of defects in the small size bin (typically < 0.1 µm or tool-specific threshold).

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Disposition decision based on inspection results: pass (within spec), fail (exceeds limits), review (requires engineering review), hold (lot placed on hold), or rework (requires reprocessing).

attributes.name: excursion_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a process excursion was detected based on defect density or count exceeding Statistical Process Control (SPC) limits.

attributes.name: inspected_area_cm2
attributes.description: Total wafer surface area inspected, measured in square centimeters. Used to calculate defect density.

attributes.name: inspection_mode
attributes.description: Inspection coverage mode: full wafer scan, die sampling, edge exclusion, or hot spot targeted inspection.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current status of the inspection run: completed (inspection finished successfully), in_progress (inspection running), failed (tool error), or aborted (inspection cancelled).

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the defect inspection was performed. Primary business event timestamp for this inspection result.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of inspection technology used: brightfield scanner, darkfield scanner, e-beam inspection, optical inspection, or macro inspection.

attributes.name: killer_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as killer defects (defects large enough or critical enough to cause die failure).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this defect inspection result record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process layer being inspected (e.g., Metal1, Poly, Contact, Via2). Identifies the fabrication layer in the stack.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the inspection results, anomalies, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: nuisance_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as nuisance (false positives or non-yield-impacting detections filtered by nuisance filter).

attributes.name: nuisance_filter_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a nuisance filter was applied to remove false positives or non-critical defects from the reported count.

attributes.name: nuisance_filter_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the nuisance filter algorithm or rule set applied during this inspection.

attributes.name: particle_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as particles (foreign material on wafer surface).

attributes.name: pattern_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as pattern defects (lithography or etch anomalies in the circuit pattern).

attributes.name: residue_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as residue (chemical or material residue remaining after processing).

attributes.name: review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether engineering review is required based on defect count, type, or pattern analysis.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the engineering review was completed.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer who reviewed the inspection results, if review was performed.

attributes.name: scratch_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as scratches (linear surface damage).

attributes.name: spc_control_limit_lower
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Lower Control Limit
attributes.description: Lower control limit for defect density used in SPC monitoring.

attributes.name: spc_control_limit_upper
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Upper Control Limit
attributes.description: Upper control limit for defect density used in SPC monitoring. Excursions above this limit trigger alerts.

attributes.name: total_defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects detected on the wafer during this inspection, including all defect types and sizes.

products.name: metrology_measurement
products.description: In-line metrology measurement record capturing critical dimension (CD), overlay, film thickness, resistivity, or other physical parameter measurements taken on a wafer at a specific process step. Captures measurement type (CD-SEM, OCD, XRF, ellipsometry, overlay), tool ID, wafer lot reference, wafer number, measurement site map, per-site values, mean, 3-sigma, range, and pass/fail disposition against spec limits. Sourced from KLA ICOS and in-line metrology tools.
products.reference: SEMI M1 / KLA Metrology / CD-SEM SEMI E89

attributes.name: metrology_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the metrology_measurement data product.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the metrology equipment that performed the measurement (e.g., CD-SEM, ellipsometer, overlay tool).

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this measurement was performed.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot on which this measurement was performed.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Metrology measurements are linked to the IC product they verify; used in Metrology Compliance reporting.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Metrology measurements in semiconductor fabs are performed within the context of a quality inspection lot. The inspection_lot provides the sampling plan, AQL, and quality context for metrology runs, e

attributes.name: lot_process_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.lot_process_run. Business justification: In-line metrology measurements are taken during or immediately after a specific lot process run. Linking process_metrology_measurement to lot_process_run provides direct traceability from the measurem

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process step at which this metrology measurement was taken.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the metrology recipe or measurement program used for this measurement.

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.spc_control_chart. Business justification: In-line metrology measurements feed directly into SPC control charts for process monitoring. Linking process_metrology_measurement to spc_control_chart enables traceability from individual metrology d

attributes.name: step_id
attributes.description: FK to process.process_process_step.process_process_step_id — Metrology measurements are taken at specific process steps. Step context is essential for measurement interpretation and SPC feeding.

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.tool_chamber. Business justification: Metrology measurements (CD, thickness, overlay) often chamber-specific. Process control, chamber matching, and qualification decisions require chamber-level measurement data in semiconductor fabs.

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific wafer within the lot that was measured.

attributes.name: cp_value
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cp) calculated from this measurement, indicating the potential capability of the process without considering centering.

attributes.name: cpk_value
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cpk) calculated from this measurement, indicating how well the process is centered and controlled within specification limits.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating the quality and reliability of the measurement data. Good indicates reliable data, Suspect indicates questionable data, Bad indicates invalid data, Uncalibrated indicates tool calibration issue.

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Pass/fail disposition of the measurement against specification limits. Pass indicates within spec, Fail indicates out of spec, Marginal indicates near limits, Rework indicates corrective action required, Hold indicates pending review.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where the measurement was performed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process layer or mask level at which this measurement was taken (e.g., M1, POLY, CONTACT).

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Lower control limit for Statistical Process Control (SPC) monitoring. Values below this trigger investigation.

attributes.name: lower_spec_limit
attributes.description: Lower specification limit for this measurement parameter. Values below this threshold fail specification.

attributes.name: max_value
attributes.description: Maximum measured value across all sites on the wafer.

attributes.name: mean_value
attributes.description: Arithmetic mean of all site measurements for this parameter.

attributes.name: measurement_mode
attributes.description: Mode in which the measurement was performed. Inline indicates production flow measurement, Offline indicates lab measurement, Engineering indicates development measurement, Qualification indicates process qualification.

attributes.name: measurement_parameter
attributes.description: Specific physical parameter being measured (e.g., critical dimension, overlay X/Y, film thickness, resistivity, reflectivity).

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Status of the measurement execution. Completed indicates successful measurement, In Progress indicates measurement underway, Failed indicates measurement error, Aborted indicates user-terminated, Pending indicates queued.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the metrology measurement was performed.

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Type of metrology measurement performed: CD-SEM (Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscopy), OCD (Optical Critical Dimension), XRF (X-Ray Fluorescence), Ellipsometry, Overlay, or Film Thickness.

attributes.name: median_value
attributes.description: Median value of all site measurements for this parameter.

attributes.name: min_value
attributes.description: Minimum measured value across all sites on the wafer.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the measurement, including any anomalies, special conditions, or operator observations.

attributes.name: range_value
attributes.description: Difference between maximum and minimum site measurements (max - min).

attributes.name: site_count
attributes.description: Total number of measurement sites sampled on the wafer.

attributes.name: spc_rule_violation
attributes.description: Description of any SPC rule violations detected (e.g., Western Electric rules, Nelson rules) such as trend, shift, or out-of-control conditions.

attributes.name: std_deviation
attributes.description: Standard deviation (1-sigma) of the site measurements, indicating within-wafer uniformity.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Target or nominal value for this measurement parameter as defined by the process specification.

attributes.name: three_sigma
attributes.description: Three times the standard deviation, representing the process variation range.

attributes.name: uniformity_percent
attributes.description: Within-wafer uniformity expressed as a percentage, calculated as (range / mean) * 100 or (3-sigma / mean) * 100 depending on convention.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the measurement values (e.g., nm, angstrom, ohm-cm, percent).

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Upper control limit for Statistical Process Control (SPC) monitoring. Values above this trigger investigation.

attributes.name: upper_spec_limit
attributes.description: Upper specification limit for this measurement parameter. Values above this threshold fail specification.

attributes.name: wafer_slot_number
attributes.description: Position of the wafer within the lot carrier or cassette.

products.name: process_technology_node
products.description: Reference master for semiconductor technology nodes (process generations) supported by the fab. Captures node name (e.g., 5nm, 3nm, 28nm, 65nm), node generation, device architecture (planar, FinFET, GAA), minimum metal pitch, gate pitch, DRAM half-pitch, introduction year, production readiness status, and associated PDK version. Serves as the top-level classification anchor for process flows, OPC rule sets, and process capability records.

attributes.name: process_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the semiconductor technology node record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Technology node development costs (R&D, process integration, PDK development) are tracked to specific cost centers for R&D capitalization decisions and technology roadmap financial planning in semicon

attributes.name: eccn_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.eccn_classification. Business justification: Process nodes (7nm, 5nm, 3nm) are controlled technologies requiring ECCN classification under EAR. Technology licensing, fab equipment exports, and foundry partnerships require node-level ECCN for com

attributes.name: product_process_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.process_node. Business justification: Technology Node Mapping aligns process nodes with product process nodes for the Technology Node Compatibility Matrix.

attributes.name: application_scope
attributes.description: Primary application domains or product families this technology node is designed to support (e.g., High Performance Computing, Mobile, Automotive, IoT, AI/ML Accelerators).

attributes.name: baseline_cpk
attributes.description: Baseline process capability index (Cpk) target for critical parameters in this technology node. Cpk measures process capability relative to specification limits.

attributes.name: baseline_yield_target_percent
attributes.description: Target baseline yield percentage (good dies per wafer) for production qualification of this technology node.

attributes.name: beol_layer_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: BEOL (Back End of Line) Layer Count
attributes.description: Number of process layers in the Back End of Line, covering metal interconnect formation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this technology node record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: design_rule_complexity
attributes.description: Complexity level of design rules for this technology node. Higher complexity indicates more restrictive DFM (Design for Manufacturability) constraints and OPC (Optical Proximity Correction) requirements.

attributes.name: device_architecture
attributes.description: Transistor architecture type used in this technology node. Planar for traditional flat transistors, FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor) for 3D fin structures, GAA (Gate All Around) for next-generation wrap-around gates, nanowire or nanosheet for advanced GAA variants.

attributes.name: dram_half_pitch_nm
attributes.description: DRAM half-pitch in nanometers, a key metric for memory density and technology node classification per ITRS standards.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this technology node is scheduled to be retired or phased out. Null for active nodes with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this technology node became effective and available for use in production or design activities.

attributes.name: euv_layer_count
attributes.description: Number of critical layers that use EUV lithography in this technology node. Zero for nodes that do not use EUV.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility (fab) where this technology node is implemented. Multiple fabs may support the same node.

attributes.name: feol_layer_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: FEOL (Front End of Line) Layer Count
attributes.description: Number of process layers in the Front End of Line, covering transistor formation steps.

attributes.name: gate_pitch_nm
attributes.description: Gate pitch in nanometers, representing the distance between adjacent transistor gates in the Front End of Line (FEOL). Key dimension for transistor density.

attributes.name: introduction_year
attributes.description: Calendar year when this technology node was first introduced or qualified for production.

attributes.name: is_baseline_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the baseline or reference technology node for a given generation. Used for comparison and benchmarking purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this technology node record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Primary lithography technology used for this node. DUV (Deep Ultraviolet), EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography), immersion lithography, dry lithography, or e-beam (electron beam) lithography.

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Total number of metal interconnect layers in the Back End of Line (BEOL) stack for this technology node.

attributes.name: minimum_metal_pitch_nm
attributes.description: Minimum metal interconnect pitch in nanometers, representing the smallest distance between adjacent metal lines in the Back End of Line (BEOL).

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code for the technology node used across systems and documentation.

attributes.name: node_generation
attributes.description: Generation classification of the technology node (e.g., Gen 1, Gen 2, Gen 3, Advanced Node, Mature Node, Legacy Node).

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the technology node (e.g., 5nm, 3nm, 7nm, 28nm, 65nm, 90nm). This is the primary business identifier for the process generation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to this technology node.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer or engineering manager responsible for this technology node definition and maintenance.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Organization or department responsible for managing and maintaining this technology node (e.g., Process Engineering, Advanced Technology Development).

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Process Design Kit (PDK) associated with this technology node. PDK contains design rules, device models, and libraries for IC design.

attributes.name: process_technology_node_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the technology node, including key features, capabilities, and differentiators.

attributes.name: production_readiness_status

attributes.name: qualification_status

attributes.name: supports_multi_patterning

attributes.name: target_performance_improvement_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage improvement in performance (speed/frequency) compared to the previous technology node generation. Part of PPA (Power Performance Area) metrics.

attributes.name: target_power_efficiency_improvement_percent

attributes.name: target_transistor_density_per_mm2
attributes.description: Target transistor density in millions of transistors per square millimeter for this technology node. Key metric for comparing node scaling and integration capability.

attributes.name: wavelength_nm
attributes.description: Primary lithography wavelength in nanometers (e.g., 193nm for DUV, 13.5nm for EUV). Critical parameter for resolution and patterning capability.

products.name: excursion
products.description: Process excursion record capturing any significant out-of-spec, out-of-control, or yield-impacting condition detected during wafer manufacturing that requires formal engineering investigation. Encompasses all yield loss events as a unified excursion type. Captures excursion detection source (SPC, inspection, metrology, electrical test), affected lot list, process step, excursion severity (minor/major/critical), yield loss mode (parametric, systematic, random, electrical), defect density, affected die count, estimated yield impact, detection timestamp, containment actions taken, root cause category, corrective action reference, investigation status, and final disposition. Serves as the single parent investigation record for all process-related yield and excursion events. Distinct from individual OCAP actions which are the immediate corrective responses. SSOT for process excursion and yield loss tracking; quality domain owns outgoing quality excursions and customer returns.

attributes.name: excursion_id
attributes.description: Primary key for excursion

attributes.name: capa_record_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Process excursions trigger investigation, containment, and corrective action costs that must be allocated to responsible cost centers for quality cost tracking and root cause financial impact analysis

attributes.name: defect_inspection_result_id

attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing equipment where the excursion occurred. Links to equipment master data.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node of the affected product. Links to technology node master data.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary wafer lot affected by this excursion. Links to the fabrication wafer lot master data.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Excursions are recorded per IC product to assess impact; required for the Excursion Impact Report.

attributes.name: lot_process_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.lot_process_run. Business justification: An excursion is triggered by an out-of-control condition detected during a specific lot process run. Linking excursion to lot_process_run provides direct traceability to the exact run conditions (equi

Quality engineers must link each excursion to its resulting NCR for IATF

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process step where the excursion was detected. Links to process step master data.

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.spc_control_chart. Business justification: excursion has spc_rule_violated: STRING which is a denormalized reference to an SPC violation. Adding spc_control_chart_id as a proper FK links the excursion to the specific SPC control chart that det

attributes.name: step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_step. Business justification: An excursion captures a significant out-of-spec or out-of-control event at a specific process step. The product description explicitly states 'out-of-spec, out-of-control, or yield-impacting' events.

attributes.name: suspected_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Process excursions frequently caused by supplier material variation (e.g., resist viscosity drift, gas purity deviation). Critical for immediate containment actions, supplier notification per quality

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.tool_chamber. Business justification: Process excursions often chamber-specific (plasma drift, contamination buildup). Root cause analysis, chamber qualification, and preventive maintenance decisions require chamber-level traceability for
